definition.measure: Cloud growth, operating growth and valuation gains

excerpts.quote: Google Cloud saw a meaningful acceleration in growth as revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion, led by an increase in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure, as well as core GCP services. • Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% and operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34%. • Other income reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily the result of net unrealized gains on our equity securities. • Net income available to common stockholders increased 298% and EPS increased 294% to $9.11.
